newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia banks' excess liquid assets up end-July.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia banks' excess liquid assets up end-July.

text.p: The Malaysian banking system's excess liquid assets rose to 2.39 billion ringgit at the end of July from 1.99 billion ringgit at June 30, the national Bernama news agency reported on Monday.

Quoting the July monthly statistical bulletin from Bank Negara, the country's central bank, Bernama said loans extended by the banking system rose to 286.93 billion ringgit at July 31 from 280.579 billion ringgit at June 30.
